title: Data viz lab (source of the Data Viz pack)
summary: The comps every Data Viz template was built and verified in: line chart - draw, donut - fill, ranked bars and gauge.
use_when: You want to see a chart pattern working before using it, copy a chart's objects into a job, or re-extract a template after changing it.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/data_viz_lab.py, then apply its PRESETS with preset.apply and edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
